mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.articles WHERE title = BTRIM(#{title}))) AS title_exists, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.articles WHERE slug = BTRIM(#{slug}))) AS slug_exists
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.articles ( writers_id, title, slug, subtitle, category, summary, md_desc, image_ids ) VALUES ( #{writersId}, BTRIM(#{title}), BTRIM(#{slug}), #{subtitle}, #{category}, #{summary}, #{mdDesc}, #{imageIdsStr} )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.articles SET writers_id = #{writersId}, title = BTRIM(#{title}), slug = BTRIM(#{slug}), subtitle = #{subtitle}, category = #{category}, summary = #{summary}, md_desc = #{mdDesc}, image_ids = #{imageIdsStr} WHERE id = #{articlesId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.articles ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM public.articles GROUP BY category ORDER BY count DESC
